snippet.title: Ace Attorney: Dual Destinies VR - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
OBJECTION!

The hit Ace Attorney series finally comes to the immersive world of VR.
Take on the roles of Phoenix Wright, Apollo Justice, and Athena Cykes—and prove your clients innocent of all charges!

Wishlist Now!
https://meta.com/experiences/ace-attorney-dual-destinies-vr/6976941495687946

------
Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Dual Destinies VR
■Release Date: TBD 2027
■Platforms: Meta VR Glasses, Meta Quest 3/3S, Quest Pro, and Quest2
■Players: Single Player
■Genre: Courtroom Battle / Narrative Adventure
■Languages: Japanese, English, French, German, Korean, Chinese (Traditional/Simplified)
■Rating: IARC 12+
■Developer/Publisher: Amata K.K.
